cards.meaning: was slipped in; was inserted on the sly
cards.example: Isiningit daw sa badyet ng Department of Agriculture ang libu-libong proyekto.
cards.exampleMeaning: Thousands of projects were reportedly slipped into the Department of Agriculture budget.
cards.note: Pandiwang pasibo mula sa 'isingit'; may pahiwatig ng palihim na paglalagay, di tulad ng neutral na 'inilagay' o 'ipinasok'.
cards.tiesTo: House insertions of about P190B into the DA 2027 budget

cards.example: Bumulusok ang halaga ng piso sa P63.95 kontra dolyar.
cards.exampleMeaning: The peso plunged to P63.95 against the dollar.
cards.note: Mas matindi at tuloy-tuloy ang pagbagsak kaysa sa 'bumagsak'; madalas sa pamagat ng balita at sa panitikan.
cards.tiesTo: Peso at a fifth straight record low

cards.example: 倘若土地出让收入继续下滑，地方政府就很难偿还债务。
cards.examplePinyin: Tǎngruò tǔdì chūràng shōurù jìxù xiàhuá, dìfāng zhèngfǔ jiù hěn nán chánghuán zhàiwù.
cards.exampleMeaning: If land-sale income keeps sliding, local governments will struggle to repay their debts.
cards.note: 书面语 conditional, more hypothetical and bookish than neutral 如果; often paired with 就 or 则 in the result clause. Contrast 一旦, which says 'once it happens'; 倘若 stays in 'suppose'.
cards.tiesTo: China land-sale revenue down 27.9% in Jan-Sep

cards.meaning: to depend on; to rely on
cards.example: 许多地方政府长期依赖土地财政。
cards.examplePinyin: Xǔduō dìfāng zhèngfǔ chángqī yīlài tǔdì cáizhèng.
cards.exampleMeaning: Many local governments have long relied on land finance.
cards.note: Formal-neutral, common in economic writing; 依赖于 is the more abstract pattern. Contrast 取决于, which describes what an outcome is determined by; 依赖 describes a dependence, often with a worried tone.
